scope: Intel objc_claimAutoreleasedReturnValue source backport and actual native ARC behavior; macho_source_version primary-source handoff to ue_pods

objc.body_adaptation: Exact modern body except acceptOptimizedReturn(/*expectsNop*/false) becomes existing acceptOptimizedReturn(); implementation and declaration guarded by __x86_64__.
objc.contract: Accept +0 return for +1 ownership: consume an existing +1 TLS handoff without another retain, otherwise call real objc_retain. It is not the unsafe +0 claim API.
objc.architecture_evidence: Modern objc-config.h:172-180 enables return-address autorelease elision only on arm64. On x86_64 acceptOptimizedReturn ignores expectsNOP and consumes/resets its TLS disposition. The old runtime already implements the same Intel TLS ownership disposition.
objc.producer_evidence: Both pinned old and modern Intel caller recognizers accept retainAutoreleasedReturnValue or unsafeClaimAutoreleasedReturnValue, not the new claim symbol. New claim callers therefore use a correct autorelease + retain fallback; this preserves lifetime rather than asserting optimization.
verified_cases: Exact pre-candidate objc4 lacks the weak-imported API (negative control)
Candidate actual dlsym/dladdr provider is the independent complete source library
nil with +0 and seeded +1 clears the real reserved TSD state
Fallback retain keeps an actual NSObject subclass alive until two matching releases
Seeded actual TSD +1 is consumed and cleared exactly once; a repeated claim performs a real retain
Original producer to existing retain helper follows actual x86 optimized callsite without retain/autorelease
Original producer to new claim helper follows actual unrecognized callsite with one autorelease and one retain; deallocation occurs on pool drain after consumer release
objc.tls_seed_limit: The isolated +1-consumption test writes the real upstream reserved pthread TSD slot. It does not claim an old producer naturally recognizes the new claim callsite. The separate original-producer tests exercise both real callsites and actual object lifetime.

macho_source_version.owner: ue_pods parallel integration; no shared macho/dyld source edited here
macho_source_version.contract: Returns false for unsupported magic or no LC_SOURCE_VERSION; success writes the original packed 64-bit version. Preserve upstream parser behavior rather than return a constant.
macho_source_version.available_build_integration: Existing pinned Apple selected-source libDarlingCacheIntrospection component and existing libSystem reexport. Its current header-selected object already provides hasMachOMagic; add the exact sourceVersion/load-command methods and API to that same component, with existing Error object, not another per-call shim.
macho_source_version.cctools_local_status: Both vendor/darling/src/external/cctools and cctools-port directories are empty in this checkout. No local libmacho implementation of this modern API was found. Original API belongs to modern libdyld.
macho_source_version.original_calling_provider: GameControllerFoundation imports macho_source_version through /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib; GameController imports objc_claimAutoreleasedReturnValue from /usr/lib/libobjc.A.dylib.
